terminal_original_signal_limitations.scope: Only terminal unexecuted original BASE entry/exit/reversal facts are inherited from hash-bound decisions and structurally checked. Filled BASE episodes come from the saved execution ledger. No terminal-only distinction changes observed PnL. All checkpoint facts, predicate results, risk execution clocks and observed paths are independently reconstructed.

details.quality_definition: Eligible closed trades entered and genuinely closed in each window; flat trades remain in expectancy denominator. Gross PF=sum wins/absolute sum losses; missing wins=0, missing losses undefined. Finite FILTER > BASE for both, no selection epsilon; FILTER closed_n >=20 for new OOS quality.
details.execution_clock: Risk signal at checkpoint m executes at close m+1; m+1 return retained, deleted tail starts m+2. Original-episode lock prevents reentry.
details.accounting_compatibility: net_pnl_usd and all window research returns use fixed-principal simple PnL. Legacy ledger pnl_usd/price_pnl_usd fields retain independently reconstructed compound-equity accounting.
details.historical_evidence: Reused historical OOS, not independent untouched evidence; all original frozen candidates preserved.
